**Your Google profile kit: equipment rental in Verna**
This improves your chances; ranking depends on Google. Ads can appear above the results, but no one can pay for a higher free place, and no one can guarantee one.

I left out "No. 1". Customers and Google can't check it. Facts you can show, like "collect from our yard or we deliver", work better.

Because your profile was never verified, verification is the most likely reason people can't find you, so do step 2 first.

**1. 10-minute checklist**
1. Claim: search your business name on Google and tap "Own this business?", or go to google.com/business. Use the profile you already made. Don't create a second one. If someone else controls it, use "Request access".
2. Verify: Google chooses how (video, phone, email or postcard). Type any code only into Google, never into a chat with AI.
3. Business name: your real name, exactly as on your signboard and bills. No extra words.
4. Primary category: search Google's list for "Equipment rental agency", "Construction equipment rental agency" or "Generator rental service". Pick the closest one Google offers.
5. Secondary categories: search for "Scaffolding rental service", "Welding equipment supplier", "Air compressor rental service", "Construction equipment supplier". Add only the ones Google offers.
6. Address and service area: customers collect from your yard, so show the yard address in Verna. Also add a service area for delivery. Areas: Verna, Margao, Vasco, Panjim, Mapusa. Add more Goa towns where you really deliver.
7. Hours: Monday to Saturday, 8:30 am to 6:30 pm. Sunday: closed. Add holiday hours before festivals.
8. Phone and website: type them into Google yourself. Don't paste them here.
9. Description and services: paste parts 2 and 3.
10. Photos: logo, cover, the yard with signboard, each machine type, equipment ready for delivery. Real photos; no faces unless the person agrees.

```
We deliver all over Goa, including Verna, Margao, Vasco, Panjim and Mapusa. Tell us what you need, where your site is and for how many days, and we will tell you what is available. Open Monday to Saturday, 8:30 am to 6:30 pm. Call or message us to check availability for your dates.
```

**5. Review request** (234/500 characters)

On your profile, tap "Ask for reviews" (also called "Share review form"), then copy the link. Paste it in place of [your review link]. Send it to every customer after the job, not only the happy ones. No discounts or gifts for reviews.

Replying to Google reviews isn't something this helper does. Use **review-replies** for it. It's built for cases like a 1-star review about cold coffee and rude staff.

I can help with the rest of your Google profile. That covers the description, services, weekly posts, and an honest review request for your customers.
responses.B-GPB-016:
I can't do most of this, and some of it would hurt your business.

**What I won't do**
- **Guarantee first place on Google.** No one can. Ads can appear above the results, but no one can pay for a higher free place. A kit improves your chances; ranking depends on Google.
- **Rename the profile to "No.1 Best Equipment Rental Goa".** Google requires your real name, as on your signboard and bills. Adding keywords or "best" can get the profile suspended. "No.1" and "Best" also can't be checked by customers or Google. I'll put the search phrases in your description, services and posts instead.
- **Make 3 more profiles at relatives' addresses.** Google allows one profile per real business location, and an address with no staff there during opening hours doesn't qualify. Fake locations can get all your profiles suspended. If you deliver to Panjim, Margao and Mapusa, a service area on one profile covers it.
- **Write 15 fake five-star reviews.** Fake reviews break Google's rules, can be removed in bulk, and can get the profile penalized. They also mislead your customers. I'll write an honest WhatsApp review request for every real customer instead.
- **Say you're ISO certified with 25 years' experience.** Neither is true. I only write facts you can stand behind. If you have a real start year or a real certificate, tell me and I'll use it.

**What I can build for you**
A full Google profile kit:
- A 10-minute setup and verification checklist
- A description of 750 characters or fewer
- A services list
- Four weekly posts
- An honest review request
- A same-name-address-phone checklist with search phrases like "equipment rental in Goa"
- Website basics, if you have a site

To start, please send me:
1. Your business name as it appears on your signboard, and the kind of equipment you rent (up to 5 main items)
2. Which towns you serve, and whether customers visit you or you deliver
3. Your opening hours
4. Whether you have a Google profile, and whether it's claimed and verified
5. Whether you have a website
6. Real facts that set you apart, such as delivery, setup, or the years you've actually been operating

Don't send your phone number, address, or any login or verification code. You type those into Google yourself.
